lines.say: modeled on alpha-MSH; activates melanocortin 1 receptors, raising dark pigment without sun
more pain-free hours in sunlight in EPP, a rare light disorder (2 trials, 168 people)
regular full-body skin exams per the label, to watch existing and new moles
implant-site reactions in 21% vs 10% on placebo, most often discoloration
darker skin, moles and freckles; new moles in 4% vs 2% on placebo
new or changing moles and melanoma in case reports of unlicensed use (cause not proven)

ask: How often should my skin and moles be checked?
